did.description: The account whose queues to report. Omitted = the requester's own account. A requester without administrative standing may name only itself.

includePeers.description: Also return the top N counterparties of each queue by message count. Omitted = no per-peer breakdown.

Response.title: Messaging — Show Queue Status — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/queue/status request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/queue/status/0.1#response.

receivePeers.description: Top senders into the receive queue. Present only when includePeers was requested.

sendPeers.description: Top recipients holding the send queue. Present only when includePeers was requested.
